change: Merged Anterior Deltoids and Posterior Deltoid into a single secondary shoulders entry. The landmine arc begins as a front raise and curves outward, engaging the anterior delt, then curves further engaging the posterior delt. Both belong in the same shoulders bucket alongside Lateral Deltoids (primary). Upper Traps secondary retained.

Added 'chest -> Clavicular Head' as secondary: the landmine press angle (~45 degrees diagonal) mimics an incline press and meaningfully activates the upper pec/clavicular head. Added 'Lower Back -> Erector Spinae' as secondary: standing unilateral lunge requires lumbar stabilization. All other entries retained.

Added 'chest -> Clavicular Head' as secondary: research confirms pecs (pec major) are engaged as secondary movers during the pressing/extending motion of the landmine tricep extension. Anterior Deltoids secondary retained.
Added 'Lower Back -> Erector Spinae' as secondary: standing rotational movement requires lumbar stabilization against the rotational load. All other entries retained.

Removed 'Lower Back -> Erector Spinae' from primary. The exercise instructions explicitly state 'do not roll over the lower spine' and the exercise targets the upper/thoracic back only. Replaced with 'mid back -> Upper Traps, Rhomboids' as the sole primary group. Lats secondary retained. The previous Lower Back primary entry was incorrect given the thoracic-only scope of this exercise.
